parameters.name: ConsumerGroupIds
parameters.description:
The consumer group IDs in the AMQP subscription. This parameter is required when **Type** is set to **AMQP**.

After you call [CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~) to create a consumer group, the consumer group ID is returned. You can call [QueryConsumerGroupList](~~170419~~) to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name, or view the consumer group ID in the IoT Platform console by choosing **Message Forwarding** > **Server-side Subscription** > **Consumer Groups**.

parameters.name: DeviceDataFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push device-reported messages. Valid values:
- **true**: yes.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: DeviceLifeCycleFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push device lifecycle change messages. Valid values:
- **true**: yes.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: DeviceStatusChangeFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push device status change notifications. Valid values:
- **true**: yes.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: DeviceTagFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push device tag change messages. Valid values:
- **true**: yes. This is valid only when **Type** is set to **AMQP**.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: DeviceTopoLifeCycleFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push device topology relationship change messages. Valid values:
- **true**: yes. This is valid only for gateway products.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: FoundDeviceListFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push sub-device discovery report messages from gateways. Valid values:
- **true**: yes. This is valid only for gateway products.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or **ID** value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: MnsConfiguration
parameters.description:
The configuration information of the MNS queue. This parameter is required when **Type** is set to **MNS**.
For specific requirements and examples, see the "MnsConfiguration definition" section below.

parameters.name: OtaEventFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push over-the-air update upgrade status notifications. Valid values:
- **true**: is.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: OtaJobFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push over-the-air update upgrade batch status notifications. Valid values:
- **true**: yes. This is valid only when **Type** is set to **AMQP**.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: OtaVersionFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push OTA module version number reports. Valid values:
- **true**: yes. This is valid only when **Type** is set to **AMQP**.
- **false** (default): no.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product in this subscription.

parameters.name: SubscribeFlags
parameters.description:
Identifies other message types for the subscribed product. The data format is JSON String.

- If you subscribe to a JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway product, you must specify **SubscribeFlags** with the following value:

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

- If you subscribe to device video stream status change notification messages, you must specify **SubscribeFlags** with the following value:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    For more information about configuring AMQP server-side subscription for **device video stream status change notification** messages, see [AMQP server-side subscription](~~2698782~~).

- If you subscribe to both of the above messages, use the following value:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

parameters.name: ThingHistoryFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push Thing Specification Language model historical data reports. Valid values:
- **true**: yes.
- **false** (default): no.
